what_this_is: A held-out set of rephrasings of every boundary probe in hive.json, written by an agent instructed not to open anything in this repository, so it never saw the routing rules or any earlier set. It measures how the console generalises to wording nobody tuned it on. Do not tune routes against it: once a rule is written to catch one of these, it stops being a held-out measurement. To improve the console, retire this set into hive.json paraphrases, have a fresh agent write the next set, and measure that one once.
ceiling_note: Per set, measured: on THIS set 9 of 80 rephrasings are routed to an agent's in-scope rule (waved through). The build fails if that count rises. Lower it when a route change brings it down; never raise it for the same set. A new set starts from its own measurement.

history.measured: 32/60 caught by the right agent (53%), 19 no match, 4 wrong agent, 5 waved through
history.then: retired into hive.json paraphrases the same day; routes widened against its failures
